answer: The strongest lever is simple: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because crystal only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, knoll is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any raven approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
